message: Smaller compounds tend to move more under adaptation
caption: All 3,344 development compounds, one saved N500 head-plus-LoRA prediction each. N500 = 400 FIT + 100 CAL per fold, one draw and seed; five reused strict-chemical development folds, not independent replicates or a fresh holdout. Unweighted absolute movement |LoRA − native| is not error reduction. Native is the released IC50-equivalent scalar conversion, not measured cellular potency. Full MW and movement ranges retained; size association is descriptive, not a causal mechanism.
design: A full-cohort continuous MW-versus-movement scatter exposes the size association without thresholds, regression lines, or selecting only successful corrections.
